# PrintSign PDF Editor
> 100% Client-Side PDF Editor, Permanent Redactor, Splitter, and Sanitizer.

PrintSign is a zero-server, zero-telemetry web application that enables users and AI agents to manipulate, reorganize, sanitize, and permanently redact PDF documents directly inside browser memory without uploading any bytes to a remote server.

## Dedicated Pages & Endpoints
- Homepage & Live Dropzone: https://printsign.org/
- Full Web Application Editor: https://printsign.org/editor
- Features & Architectural Specifications: https://printsign.org/features

- Frequently Asked Questions: https://printsign.org/faq

## Core Capabilities
- **Permanent Redaction:** 300 DPI canvas raster burn-in with Trailer and Catalog indirect object graph traversal garbage collection. Purges underlying vector text and binary canary strings completely (NIST SP 800-88 compliant).
- **Page Organization:** Rotate clockwise 90°, delete single or multiple pages, reorder by drag-and-drop, insert blank pages, duplicate pages, visual cropping.
- **Split & Merge:** Multi-file merging in client memory; page range splitting (e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10) with multi-file client-side ZIP packaging via fflate.
- **Metadata Scrubbing:** Complete purge of Info dictionary keys (Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator, Producer, CreationDate, ModDate) and raw XML RDF XMP streams.
- **High-DPI Rasterizer:** Render PDF pages to PNG, JPEG, or WebP at 72, 150, 300, or 600 DPI, with flattening to image-only PDF.
- **Offline PWA:** Fully cached via Service Worker. Operates on air-gapped computers with zero internet connection.
- **Local Autosave:** Preserves drafts locally in browser IndexedDB with zero cloud exposure.

## Security & Verification Posture
- 0 bytes transmitted over network.
- 0 external runtime CDNs or remote font endpoints.
- Isolated multi-document history and redaction state.
- Automated canary string byte-level audit on all redactions.
